label: Signed numbers
subgoals: Place negative numbers left of zero
Read positions on the number line

visual.title: Which number is farther left?
visual.caption: A signed number line places negative values left of zero. The marker positions are the numbers themselves, so comparison is the same as reading left to right.

predict.question: Which statement about -4 and 2 is true?
options: They are the same distance from zero
predict.explain: -4 lies four units left of zero and 2 lies two units right, so -4 is farther left and -4 < 2.
